provider: Azure for Students (and Azure for Students Starter)

free_tier.stated: $100 credit per 12 months plus free monthly amounts of 20+ services; no credit card required. Explicitly renewable: 'Renew your subscription annually and continue to get free access to Azure as long as you're a student.' Starter tier (13-17) gives services without the $100.
